title: Accounts Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Accounts Executive – Visakhapatnam

Company: Steel on Call Services India Private Limited
Location: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh
Department: Finance & Accounts
Designation:
excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTIONAccounts Executive – VisakhapatnamCompany: Steel on Call Services India Private LimitedLocation: Visakhapatnam, Andhra PradeshDepartment: Finance & AccountsDesignation: Accounts ExecutiveExperience: 3–5 YearsIndustry: Steel / Iron & Steel / Trading / Manufacturing preferredEmployment Type: Full-TimeReporting To: Accounts Manager / Finance ManagerContact Person Name : Ch RevathiContact Person Number : 62811005361. Job PurposeThe Accounts Executive will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, processing invoices, reconciling accounts, handling GST and TDS compliance, and supporting monthly and annual financial reporting. The candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and proficiency in accounting software.2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Accounting & BookkeepingMaintain day-to-day accounting transactions and financial records.Prepare and record sales invoices, purchase bills, debit notes, and credit notes.Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable.Maintain general ledger, cash book, bank book, and journal entries.Ensure proper documentation and filing of all financial transactions.B. GST, TDS & Statutory ComplianceAssist in GST return preparation and filing, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.Verify GST invoices, input tax credit (ITC), and GST reconciliations.Calculate and process TDS deductions and support TDS return filing.Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements and payment deadlines.Coordinate with auditors and consultants for statutory compliance.C. Bank & Vendor ReconciliationPerform bank reconciliation statements (BRS) regularly.Reconcile vendor and customer accounts.Follow up on outstanding payments and receivables.Verify supplier invoices, payment terms, and supporting documents.Maintain accurate records of vendor payments and customer collections.D. Financial ReportingAssist in preparing monthly financial statements and management reports.Prepare outstanding receivables and payables reports.Track expenses and support expense verification and control.Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.Provide accounting data and supporting documents for audits.E. Documentation & CoordinationMaintain organized financial records, vouchers, invoices, and tax documents.Coordinate with procurement, sales, logistics, and other departments for invoice verification.Ensure timely processing of bills and payments.Support internal and external audit requirements.3. Educational QualificationsB.Com in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce is mandatory.M.Com or MBA in Finance will be an added advantage.Candidates with relevant professional accounting certifications may also be considered.4. Experience & Technical Skills3–5 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.Practical knowledge of GST, TDS, bank reconciliation, and ledger maintenance.Proficiency in Tally Prime or other accounting software.Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, lookups, and reconciliation reports.Familiarity with ERP systems and e-invoicing/e-way bill processes is preferred.Experience in steel trading, iron and steel, manufacturing, or trading companies will be an advantage.5. Required Skills & CompetenciesStrong numerical and analytical skills.High attention to detail and accuracy.Good organizational and time-management skills.Ability to meet accounting and statutory deadlines.Good communication and coordination skills.Integrity and confidentiality in handling financial information.Ability to work independently and as part of a team.6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries.Timely preparation of bank and ledger reconciliations.Compliance with GST and TDS deadlines.Timely processing of vendor invoices and payments.Accuracy of accounts payable and receivable reports.Proper maintenance of accounting records and audit documentation.7. Preferred Candidate ProfileWe are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive with 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience, sound knowledge of statutory compliance, and proficiency in Tally Prime and MS Excel. Candidates with experience in steel trading or related industries and the ability to manage accounting operations independently will be preferred.8. Work LocationVisakhapatnam, Andhra PradeshInterested candidates with relevant experience and accounting expertise are encouraged to apply.

title: Field Sales Manager - Karimnagar
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Field Sales Manager – B2C Sales (Steel Industry)

Company: Steel on Call Services India Private Limited
Department: Sales & Business Development
Designation: Field Sales Manager – B2C
excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTIONField Sales Manager – B2C Sales (Steel Industry)Company: Steel on Call Services India Private LimitedDepartment: Sales & Business DevelopmentDesignation: Field Sales Manager – B2CIndustry: Steel / Iron & Steel – MandatoryExperience: 6–7 YearsEmployment Type: Full-TimeReporting To: General Manager / Senior ManagementWork Location:  (Territory-Based) - Warangal / Karimnagar1. Job PurposeThe Field Sales Manager – B2C will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new customers, managing assigned territories, and expanding the company's presence in the retail steel market. The role involves direct field sales, customer relationship management, dealer and retailer network development, lead generation, and achieving sales targets across assigned territories.2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Territory Sales ManagementManage and develop assigned territories to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.Identify potential markets, new business opportunities, and untapped customer segments.Prepare territory-wise sales plans and execute strategies to increase market penetration.Conduct regular field visits to monitor market conditions, customer requirements, and competitor activities.Ensure effective coverage of all key locations within the assigned territory.B. B2C Sales & Customer AcquisitionGenerate sales from individual customers, homeowners, contractors, fabricators, and small construction businesses.Identify and convert potential customers for steel products, including TMT bars, structural steel, MS products, and other relevant steel materials.Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail customers and end users.Generate leads through field visits, references, local networking, and other sales channels.Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on their needs.C. Dealer, Retailer & Channel DevelopmentDevelop and maintain relationships with local steel dealers, retailers, fabricators, and contractors to support B2C sales.Identify potential channel partners and expand the company's customer network.Build a strong referral network to generate repeat business and new leads.Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order processing and customer service.D. Sales Planning & Target AchievementAchieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and customer acquisition objectives.Prepare daily visit plans, weekly sales reports, and monthly territory performance reports.Track sales pipelines, follow up on leads, and ensure timely conversion of enquiries into orders.Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions wherever required.Maintain accurate customer information, sales records, and market intelligence.E. Payment Follow-Up & Customer ServiceCoordinate with customers and internal teams regarding order status, delivery schedules, and product availability.Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collections in accordance with company policies.Resolve customer concerns and ensure a positive buying experience.Develop long-term customer relationships to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.F. Market Research & Competition AnalysisMonitor competitor pricing, product availability, promotional activities, and market trends.Identify new growth opportunities within assigned territories.Provide regular feedback to management regarding customer preferences, demand patterns, and market developments.3. Educational QualificationsBachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline.MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an added advantage.4. Required Experience & Skills6–7 years of experience in field sales, preferably in the steel or iron and steel industry.Mandatory experience in steel product sales and territory management.Strong understanding of the retail steel market and B2C customer acquisition.Proven track record of achieving sales targets and expanding customer networks.Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.Ability to independently manage territories and travel extensively for field sales.Strong lead-generation, sales planning, and follow-up capabilities.Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and CRM software is preferred.A valid two-wheeler or four-wheeler driving licence and own vehicle will be an advantage, depending on company requirements.5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.Number of new customers acquired.Territory-wise revenue growth and market penetration.Number of customer visits and qualified leads generated.Lead-to-order conversion rate.Repeat customer business and customer retention.Timely payment collections and reduction in overdue receivables.Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports.6. Candidate ProfileThe ideal candidate should be a target-driven sales professional with strong field execution skills, hands-on experience in steel sales, and the ability to independently manage assigned territories. The candidate must be proactive in acquiring new B2C customers, developing local market networks, and driving sustainable sales growth.7. CompensationSalary and incentives will be based on the candidate's experience, current compensation, and suitability for the role.8. How to ApplyInterested candidates with 6–7 years of relevant steel industry sales experience and a proven track record in B2C sales and territory management are encouraged to apply.
